function.name: calculate_magnetic_field
function.description: Calculate the magnetic field at a certain distance from a straight wire carrying current using Ampere’s Law.

current.description: The current flowing through the wire in amperes.

distance.description: The distance from the wire at which to calculate the magnetic field in meters.

permeability.description: The permeability of free space. The default value is 4π × 10^−7 N/A^2.
